messages:
julia: Heads-up — product asked for guidance on prefetch/multiplexing for the vectors endpoint when clients send mixed-dimension batches. Can we lock a policy before we update console docs?
omar: Short: we cannot concatenate different dims into a single tensor. We can multiplex into the same request window by splitting server-side or padding, but both have tradeoffs (latency vs memory/cost).
kai: Padding smells bad — it increases byte-cost and can blow payload limits. I think server-side per-dim batching + routing to dim-specialized workers is safer.
maria: Proposal: API accepts mixed-dim payloads (for developer ergonomics) but server will split into per-dim sub-batches. Console shows a "split preview" and estimates cost & shards.
sam: If we split server-side, we must emit telemetry for each sub-batch: dims, token_count, latency_us, and split_reason so we can trace regressions back to request examples.
julia: :thumbsup: Also need clear quota semantics — count the original caller's units against their quota (not multiply by number of sub-batches). Otherwise customers get billed twice.
omar: Implementation detail idea: preflight endpoint returns a plan header, e.g. `X-Prefetch-Plan: 512:3,768:2; est_us=4200` and `X-Split-Strategy: per_dim`. Use that for console preview and SDK dry-run.
eng-bot: deploy-bot: Deploy for "prefetch-splitting" is scheduled to staging on 2025-06-10T03:00Z.
kai: Edge case: a single item huge enough that when split it still exceeds 4MB payload limit for a sub-batch — we should fast-fail with `413` + explicit guidance (example payload, suggested chunking) rather than opaque error.
maria: UX: console should surface a sample payload inspector that shows how many sub-batches, which model variants, and estimated cost per sub-batch. Also include an "allow_mixed_dims" toggle.
sam: Telemetry tags: `split_strategy=per_dim_prefetch`, `split_count`, `subbatch_size_bytes`. Add alerting on rising `split_count` for a customer to catch regressions.
julia: Rollout plan: feature-flag default off; opt-in via console toggle; ramp 0% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with metric gates: P95 latency <= 150ms delta and cost delta <= 10% at each ramp step.
omar: Quota-on-fail policy: if some sub-batches fail, prefer partial success semantics (like bulk endpoints) and return `206` with per-item statuses. This keeps clients in control.
kai: For RPC/SDK ergonomics we might instead return `200` with a `per_item_status` array in the body to avoid clients needing to handle 206. Need to spec both.
maria: I'll mock wireframes and an "examples" tab for SDKs showing `allow_mixed_dims=true` and how to interpret `X-Prefetch-Plan`.
julia: I'll write a short RFC with the split policy, header contract, sample responses (200/206), and the console wireframes. Will tag infra/telemetry/sre for review.
julia: sample preflight response for SDKs: ```HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json
X-Prefetch-Plan: 512:3,768:2;est_us=4200
{
  "plan": [
    {"dims":512,"count":3,"model_variant":"v1-512"},
    {"dims":768,"count":2,"model_variant":"v1-768"}
  ],
  "warnings": ["items > 1MB will be split into multiple sub-batches"]
}
```
julia: TL;DR: accept mixed dims for ergonomics, split server-side into per-dim sub-batches, keep quota charging based on original request, surface split preview + cost in console, emit detailed telemetry, and rollout behind a flag with metric gates.
maria: sounds good — will start mocks and PR for console UX.
omar: will prototype preflight header + planner.
kai: will add fast-fail 413 messages and SDK guidance.
sam: will add telemetry tags and alert rules.
julia: thanks all — I'll post the RFC link once it's up. :party:
